messages:
Leah: Quick sync — we're enabling the per-tenant entitlement toggle for AcmeCorp tomorrow 03:00 UTC. This is allowlist + contract gating + VIP bypass. Need preflight checklist and a short code-review on the runtime flag check. Who can ✅?
Sanjay: I can do the code-review. share the PR and config snippet.
Tara: I’ll run the ops preflight (infra + canary). planning a 5% canary of traffic for 15m, then 25% if stable.
Kevin: FYI: we should preserve zero-downtime for sessions with KV-cache. Add `force-kv-refresh: false` in rollout config.
Leah: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/flags/pulls/412 — includes allowlist + contract gating. snippet below for the flag routing logic.
Leah: ```json
{
  "flag": "per_tenant_entitlement",
  "scope": "tenant",
  "allowlist": ["acme-corp"],
  "contract_gate": {
    "required_plan": "enterprise_plus",
    "enforce": true
  },
  "vip_bypass": {
    "enabled": true,
    "percent_canary": 5
  }
}
```
Sanjay: Code notes: add explicit fallback to `model-compat-v1` if contract gate check fails. Also log tenant-id + contract-id for 5k events/min sample.
Tara: Ops checklist (I’ll run):
- Verify allowlist entries in DB: `select tenant_id from tenant_flags where flag='per_tenant_entitlement'`
- Confirm rollout queue length < 2000
- Ensure autoscaler margin +20% for 30m
- Canary monitor: 5xx rate, latency p95, cost-per-token spike
Kevin: Rollback plan: set `vip_bypass.enabled=false` and set `allowlist` empty, then revert PR if issues. Make sure webhook to PagerDuty is set.
Leah: @deploy-bot can you schedule canary at 03:00 UTC and tag the deploy with `acme-entitlement-canary`?
deploy-bot: Scheduled: deploy `flags-service` canary at 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z for 15m. CI: green. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Alert hooks configured: PagerDuty -> on-call infra, Slack -> #incidents. Canary alert thresholds: p95 latency +300ms, error rate +0.5%.
Sanjay: I'll leave a small piece of runtime guard `if (!tenant.isInAllowlist && !tenant.hasContract) { fallback(); }` with a metric `flag_gate_fail` so we can track.
Tara: I'm going to run the DB query + propagation test now, will post results in 10m.
Kevin: small nit in PR: remove debug `console.log` in `flag-checker.js` and add tests for `contract_gate` truthy/falsey.
Leah: Perfect. After code-review + ops green, we go canary. If canary healthy at +25% after 30m, we can ramp to 100% per SLA. Otherwise rollback immediately. :three: :two: :one:
Tara: DB query done — allowlist shows `acme-corp` entry and contract flags set. propagation latency < 2s.
Sanjay: PR updated with fallback + metric. PTAL.
Kevin: LGTM, tests pass locally.
Leah: Thanks all — will monitor during canary. I’ll DM the customer success manager to let AcmeCorp know we’re starting a controlled enablement window.
Tara: If anything trips the canary alert I’ll mute traffic and notify. tagging @oncall if triggered.
Leah: End-to-end runbook attached in PR (see docs/flags/acme-onboard.md).
